# Tables

Markdown tables render as plain, compact tables. Dataframes from notebooks render as interactive tables with search, sorting and paging.

## Markdown tables

| Network | Stations | Median distance |
|---------|---------:|----------------:|
| North   | 412      | 3.1 km          |
| West    | 287      | 4.6 km          |
| South   | 158      | 6.2 km          |

: Synthetic example data {.striped}

## Dataframes

A marimo dataframe output keeps its interactivity: type in the search box, click a column to sort, and download the rows as CSV. marimo saves only the first page of a table, so write `mo.ui.table(df, pagination=False)` to include every row.

## Wide tables

A table wider than the column scrolls sideways inside its frame instead of pushing the page wider.
